# Y gy

y.gy is a URL shortener and QR code generator that allows users to create short, memorable links from long URLs, customize them with unique endings, and integrate with an API for programmatic link creation.

Category: Marketing. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/y-gy/.

## Actions

- **Create Tag**: Create a new tag.
- **Create Y.gy Short Link**: Create a new short link with optional custom domain or alias.
- **Delete a tag by ID**: Delete a tag.
- **Delete Y.GY Short Link**: Delete a specific short link by its id.
- **Get all links** (read-only): Fetch all short links with optional pagination.
- **Get all tags** (read-only): Retrieve all tags associated with the organization.
- **Get Short Link Details** (read-only): Retrieve details for a short link.
- **Register User**: Register a new user account.
